title: Force shut down the Linux system
summary: Power off the computer immediately without waiting for services to stop gracefully. Use this if the system is frozen or unresponsive.

steps.explain: This command forces the system to power off immediately. It does not wait for services to stop gracefully, which can lead to data loss if files are being written.
steps.expect: The system will power off immediately.

rollback.explain: There is no rollback for a forced shutdown once the power is cut. You must restart the computer manually.

warnings: This can cause data loss or filesystem corruption if files are currently being written.
Only use this if the system is unresponsive and a normal shutdown is not working.
